name: product
summary: A product's specification and its playbook: Atlas, who carries a product from an idea to a published knowledge base, the PRD captured section by section through the curate gates, and the PRD and architecture site read from the graph.

changelog.note: The product pack: Atlas, the product playbook; prd-build; the prd-site view, whose architecture half is optional. Split from prd-architecture-studio. Needs OTO 0.11.17.

_about: The pack's identity: its release rises on every published change; `ontology` names the ontology embedded under ontology/ and where it came from; `domain` is the category it belongs to.
